path.description: Start where your experience takes you. Move from implementation to deployment, then explore algorithms and collaborative development.

lottery.title: Java Lottery Project
lottery.description: Build a complete lottery application while connecting Java fundamentals, frontend and backend implementation, and deployment.
lottery.audience: Learners starting Java or looking to take their first project online.
topics: Java environment setup and language fundamentals
Lottery probabilities, statistics, and random numbers
Frontend and backend implementation from scratch
Nginx, automatic startup, and single-server high availability
DNS, deployment, operations, and Alibaba Cloud DevOps
lottery.goal: Complete a small project independently, from local development to a live deployment.

algorithms.title: Data Structures & Algorithms
algorithms.description: Explore classic textbooks, JDK collection implementations, and common interview problems to understand how data structures work and how to reason about solutions.
algorithms.audience: Learners with Java basics who want a deeper understanding of collections and algorithms.
topics: Core concepts drawn from classic textbooks
Data structures through JDK collection source code
Common problems informed by interview experience
algorithms.goal: Understand common data structures and algorithms, and make informed choices when using Java collections.

project.title: Practical Enterprise Development
project.description: Work through a real development process, from requirements and design reviews to integration and deployment, with architect guidance and peer discussion.
project.audience: Learners who can write basic application code and want to understand team development.
topics: Architect guidance on design and implementation
Peer discussion, code reviews, and integration
project.goal: Experience the full process from requirements to deployment, and understand how design, implementation, and collaboration connect.
steps: TRD analysis and requirements alignment · 3 sessions
API design and Swagger definitions · 2 sessions

mentor.title: Learn from hands-on experience
mentor.name: Zhige

experience: Tongcheng Travel: international flights and billions of global fare records
Missfresh: search and recommendation for a major traffic entry point
Missfresh: an algorithm platform supporting supply chain purchasing, sales, replenishment, and distribution
An education platform in China: technical director experience
A new retail company: intelligent supply chain replenishment
